jobs.title: Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
About the job

**Company Description** BASIC Home Loan is India’s first automated platform for secured lending, with a special focus on the affordable housing segment. The organization blends technology with a strong on\-ground “phygital” network of expert home loan agents to guide customers from initial research through loan approval and disbursal. This model enables BASIC Home Loan to efficiently serve customers in both major cities and Tier 2 and Tier 3 regions that are often underserved by other digital lenders. By automating key steps and improving transparency, the company reduces costs and simplifies the home loan experience. BASIC Home Loan is driven by the mission of making housing more accessible and changing home loans for good.  
**Role Description** This is a full\-time, on\-site Relationship Manager role based in the Pune Division. The Relationship Manager will manage end\-to\-end customer relationships, including understanding home loan needs, explaining product offerings, and guiding applicants through documentation, eligibility checks, and the approval process. The role involves coordinating with internal credit, operations, and partner bank teams to ensure smooth processing and timely disbursal of loans. The Relationship Manager will build and grow a network of referral partners and local agents, drive lead generation activities, and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective customers. Daily responsibilities include following up with leads, resolving customer queries, ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements, and regularly tracking and reporting sales performance.  
**Qualifications**

* Strong customer relationship and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial products in clear, simple terms.
* Proven experience in sales or business development, preferably in home loans, mortgages, or retail banking.
* Ability to manage loan documentation, basic financial analysis, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
* Comfort working in an on\-site environment, with strong networking skills to engage local agents, partners, and customers in the Pune Division.
* Solid organizational and time\-management skills, including the ability to handle multiple cases simultaneously and meet targets.
* Working knowledge of digital tools and CRM systems to track leads, update customer information, and prepare reports.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, or a related field; relevant certifications in banking or housing finance are a plus.
* Prior experience in affordable housing finance or secured lending is an advantage, along with familiarity with Tier 2 and Tier 3 market dynamics.

Pay: ₹18,335\.28 \- ₹42,815\.28 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Experience:

* Loan officer: 1 year (Required)
* DSA: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
\# Business Analyst

\#\# Job Summary

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and analytical Business Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to understand business needs, gather and document requirements, and support the delivery of high\-quality technology solutions. The Business Analyst will play a key role in improving business processes and ensuring that solutions align with organizational goals.

\#\# Key Responsibilities

\* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.

\* Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirement elicitation sessions.

\* Translate business needs into clear functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

\* Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for process improvement.

\* Create and maintain business requirement documents (BRDs), functional requirement documents (FRDs), process flows, and use cases.

\* Work closely with product owners, project managers, developers, QA teams, and solution architects throughout the project lifecycle.

\* Support Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and user story grooming.

\* Assist in defining project scope, priorities, and business objectives.

\* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by preparing test scenarios, coordinating with business users, and validating delivered functionality.

\* Identify project risks, issues, and dependencies, and recommend appropriate solutions.

\* Ensure delivered solutions meet business requirements and quality standards.

\* Maintain comprehensive project documentation and communicate project status to stakeholders.

\#\# Required Qualifications

\* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

\* 3–7 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role.

\* Strong understanding of business analysis methodologies and best practices.

\* Experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements.

\* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.

\* Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall project environments.

\* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.

\* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

\#\# Preferred Qualifications

\* Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Visio, or similar collaboration and documentation tools.

\* Knowledge of SQL and basic data analysis.

\* Experience working on digital transformation or enterprise application projects.

\* Familiarity with API integrations and system interfaces.

\* Business Analysis certifications such as CBAP, CCBA, or ECBA are a plus.

\#\# Key Skills

\* Requirements Gathering and Analysis

\* Business Process Modeling

\* Stakeholder Management

\* User Story Writing

\* Functional Documentation

\* Process Improvement

\* Agile/Scrum Methodologies

\* UAT Planning and Support

\* Communication and Presentation Skills

\* Critical Thinking and Problem Solving

\* Risk Analysis and Decision Making

\#\# What We Offer

\* Competitive salary and benefits

\* Opportunities for professional growth and career development

\* Collaborative and inclusive work environment

\* Exposure to innovative technologies and challenging projects

\* Flexible work arrangements, where applicable

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Product Manager, Advanced Enterprise Data Platform
jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* Experience working in data, enterprise, platform or infrastructure.
* Experience working in a geographically distributed team with cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Experience managing complex data platforms, drafting detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), and executing long\-term product roadmaps.
* Deep knowledge of AI/ML foundations, RAG, and semantic modeling.
* Ability to define platform success metrics from user feedback while ensuring strict data privacy and security compliance.


**About The Job**
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
   

  

 One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
   

  

 As a Product Manager for the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP), you will drive the direction to transform Google’s data landscape into an AI\-ready ecosystem. You will lead the development of advanced semantic and reasoning capabilities, such as hybrid search, enterprise knowledge graphs, and GraphRAG, to unify our currently fragmented data space. By bridging structured and unstructured sources, you will enable autonomous agents to execute high\-stakes business workflows with deterministic accuracy and safety. You will collaborate across cross\-functional domains to drive product\-market fit, ensuring our platform provides the secure, governed, and certified data foundation required to power Google’s next generation of agentic intelligence.
   

  

 At Corp Eng, we build world\-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end\-to\-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive the platform's goal by balancing immediate operational needs with a clear roadmap for an AI\-ready, unified enterprise data ecosystem.
* Generate and define detailed product requirements and feature specifications to solve complex data fragmentation and governance challenges.
* Partner with business units to align dependencies and ensure the platform meets wide\-ranging enterprise requirements.

**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S\&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com.
 



**About Chubb India** 




 At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work® for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow
 



 With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start\-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution\-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape.
 



 We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real\-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.
 



**Position Details** 




**Job Title:** 
 Technical Product Manager
 



**Function/Department:** 
 Technology
 



**Experience:** 
 10–15 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




**Position Summary:** 




 We are seeking an experienced Technical Product Manager to drive the end\-to\-end planning, execution, and delivery of complex technology programs across Chubb India’s digital transformation portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of technology, product, and delivery – requiring a strong technical foundation to engage credibly with engineering teams, combined with the program management discipline to orchestrate cross\-functional initiatives at scale. The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of full stack technology landscapes (including Node.js\-based platforms, cloud\-native architectures, and microservices), hands\-on experience managing Agile and SAFe delivery at enterprise scale, and a product mindset that keeps customer and business outcomes at the center of every decision.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery of large\-scale technology programs spanning multiple engineering squads, from initiation and planning through to production release and benefit realization
* Define and manage program roadmaps, release plans, milestone schedules, and dependency maps across cross\-functional teams (Engineering, QA, DevOps, Architecture, Product, Business)
* Serve as the primary interface between business stakeholders and engineering teams – translating strategic goals and business requirements into actionable product backlogs, epics, and user stories
* Drive Agile / SAFe delivery ceremonies: PI planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, scrum\-of\-scrums, and program increment tracking
* Maintain a prioritized and groomed product backlog; lead backlog refinement sessions with engineering leads and architects to ensure clarity, sizing accuracy, and technical feasibility
* Identify, assess, and proactively manage program risks, issues, and blockers; escalate with proposed solutions rather than problems alone
* Engage credibly with Engineering Managers, architects, and senior developers on technical solutioning, architectural trade\-offs, API design, microservices decomposition, and cloud deployment strategies
* Define and track program KPIs, OKRs, and delivery metrics (velocity, cycle time, defect escape rate, release frequency); present dashboards and status reports to senior leadership and global stakeholders
* Govern scope, budget, and resource allocation across programs; flag deviations early and drive corrective actions
* Champion CI/CD adoption, DevOps maturity, and engineering best practices as enablers of faster, safer delivery
* Collaborate with QA and DevOps teams to define release readiness criteria, manage change control, and govern go\-live decisions
* Lead vendor and third\-party partner coordination where applicable; manage SLAs, contractual deliverables, and integration dependencies
* Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement within and across delivery teams
* Stay updated with emerging technologies, industry trends, and digital insurance innovations to inform product and program strategy



  





**Technical Skills:** 



* Solid understanding of full stack web application architecture: front\-end (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript / TypeScript, Angular / Vue.js) and back\-end (Node.js, Java, Python, or .NET)
* Familiarity with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, microservices architecture, and event\-driven systems – sufficient to review technical designs and challenge assumptions
* Working knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases: SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL), NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra)
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) – understanding of deployment models, scalability patterns, and cost governance
* Hands\-on experience with Agile delivery tools: Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and release management frameworks
* Exposure to automated testing frameworks and quality assurance practices
* Familiarity with version control systems: Git, GitHub / GitLab / Bitbucket
* Proficiency in program reporting tools and executive dashboards (PowerBI, Tableau, or similar)

**Summary**
 This role sits at the core of driving data\-driven, personalized omnichannel engagement and digital marketing transformation across markets. jobs.title: Software Engineering & Test Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:
**What we are looking for**
---------------------------


We are seeking a software\-quality engineering leader who has personally written code, built automated test frameworks and led test teams. This is not a manual QA management role. The ideal candidate understands software architecture, CI/CD, automation pipelines, system testing, industrial product validation and how to partner with senior development managers so quality is engineered into the product rather than inspected at the end.**About the Role**
------------------


This manager role will lead the transformation of testing into a modern quality engineering discipline for industrial automation software. The leader will manage test engineers and automation engineers, define the test strategy, embed quality gates into pipelines, expand automation coverage and work as a strong functional partner to the two Grade 9 Senior Software Engineering Managers. The role should be technically credible and influential, while reflecting a scope one level more focused than the senior software engineering manager roles.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead software test, automation, validation and quality engineering talent reporting into the Hyderabad organization.
* Own the quality\-engineering strategy across control software, modern platform products, system integration and release readiness.
* Partner with development managers to make quality a shared engineering responsibility, not a downstream QA function.
* Improve automated testing coverage, CI/CD quality gates, regression cycle time, defect prevention and release confidence.
* Coach test engineers toward stronger coding, automation, framework development and system\-quality skills.

**Team Leadership**
-------------------

* Lead, mentor and grow test engineers into modern quality engineers with strong coding, automation, system thinking and product\-quality orientation.
* Recruit talent capable of building frameworks, writing robust automated tests and influencing developers technically.
* Create an environment where test engineers collaborate early with developers, product owners, UX, systems engineers and architects.
* Operate with strong functional leadership while partnering with Grade 9 senior engineering managers on quality strategy, release readiness and engineering discipline.

**Technical Leadership**
------------------------

* Define test architecture for complex products spanning mature control software, modern cloud/platform components, APIs, front ends and system integration.
* Guide automation strategy across unit, API, service, UI, integration, hardware/edge\-in\-the\-loop where relevant, regression and exploratory testing.
* Partner with MBSE/System Engineering to connect requirements, system behavior, verification strategy and automated validation.
* Use AI\-assisted testing where valuable, including test\-case generation, test\-data generation, defect triage, log analysis and automation maintenance.

**Project Management**
----------------------

* Plan test cycles, automation roadmap, resourcing and release\-readiness activities in lockstep with the development organizations.
* Track and report quality risks, automation progress, release confidence and improvement plans to engineering and product leadership.
* Manage day\-to\-day quality execution with a practical, hands\-on operating style appropriate for a functional manager role.

**Communication and Collaboration**
-----------------------------------

* Act as a technically credible quality partner to both Senior Software Engineering Managers, collaborating on quality standards early in design and development.
* Partner with UX and Product Management on acceptance criteria, usability validation and user\-facing quality bars.
* Communicate quality risks and release readiness clearly to technical leaders and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Continuous Improvement**
--------------------------

* Continuously improve automated coverage, pipeline reliability, regression time, defect prevention and quality metrics.
* Shift the organization from manual validation dependency toward continuous, automated and risk\-based confidence building.
* Use engineering metrics such as DORA, escaped defects, flaky\-test rate, automation coverage, cycle time and release\-readiness indicators to drive improvement.

**Tools \& Project Management**
-------------------------------

* GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI or equivalent CI/CD tooling; Jira; Confluence; GitHub Enterprise.
* Automation frameworks such as PyTest, Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Robot Framework, CppUTest, JUnit, NUnit or comparable tools.
* Static analysis, code coverage, test reporting, artifact management, containerized test environments and observability/log\-analysis tools.


(External) English Qualifications:
**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* 12\+ years of software engineering, quality engineering, test automation or validation experience, including substantial hands\-on coding experience.
* 3\-5\+ years of people leadership experience managing test engineers, SDETs, automation engineers or quality engineering teams.
* Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Python, C\#, C\+\+, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript or similar.
* Proven experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with system/integration testing for complex software products, preferably including industrial automation, embedded/edge systems, OT software or regulated environments.
* Working knowledge of TDD, BDD, test pyramid, contract testing, performance testing, security testing, static analysis and release\-quality metrics.
* Experience collaborating with Product Management, UX, Systems Engineering/MBSE, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Cybersecurity and DevOps/DevSecOps teams in a scaled product\-development environment…

Unlike traditional support analytics roles focused on volume and efficiency, this role emphasizes signal over noise—identifying patterns in nuanced issues, shaping meaningful metrics, and ensuring support data reflects real product and customer challenges. This role reports to the Manager of Support Operations and will partner closely with Support leadership, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success.

* Support demand and trends
* Backlog health and case lifecycle
* Escalations and recurring issue patterns
* Evaluate the effectiveness of AI\-enabled support capabilities, identifying where outputs are inaccurate, misleading, or fail to support complex support scenarios.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Manager(Enterprise SaaS)
jobs.description:
**Title: Senior Platform Manager (Enterprise SaaS)**
**Location: In Office, Bangalore
   

  

 Type: Full\-Time**
**The Role**
 We're looking for a Platform Manager who can bring structure to chaos.
   

  

 You'll be defining the specs, juggling two customer\-facing co\-founders to get alignment on what gets built with a clear why.
   

  

 You'll ensure everything in the backlog is well\-groomed, technically feasible, and mapped to real customer pain points as seen by different teams — so that engineers can build fast and correctly the first time. The negative KR is the number of releases by the engineering team that get stuck in the beta environment because of a lack of stakeholder alignment.
   

  

 This means you'll do a bit of everything: write specs, talk to customer\-facing teams, jump into QA, and argue for clarity when others want speed.
   

  

 We have structured this in Responsibilities and Accountabilities, where responsibilities is your personal day\-to\-day while accountability is to get it done by other folks in the company.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own and groom the platform backlog across core modules, integrations, and infrastructure initiatives
* Work with customer facing teams (CS, Sales, etc) to translate customer feedback into prioritized roadmap items
* Write clear, actionable, detailed specs and structured user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can directly execute against
* Ruthlessly prioritize—decide what can make it into the sprint and what can't
* Build with enterprise customers in mind—permissions, audit trails, versioning, and configurability should be first\-class citizens
* Learn and internalize compliance expectations (21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485, SOC 2\)
* Keep an eye on the competition and best practices from top\-tier B2B SaaS players


**Accountability**
* Partner with Product Marketing to ensure positioning aligns with how the product actually works
* Keep Sales and Support in the loop when platform behavior changes
* Maintain internal product documentation and decision logs (the "why" behind each feature)
* Keep traceability between specs, tickets, and release notes intact


**Skills \& Qualifications**
* At least 3 years of experience in a Product, Engineering, or QA coordination role (enterprise SaaS preferred)
* Strong enterprise product understanding—comfortable discussing best practices in how enterprise products are made, almost having a bias for boring things like bulk actions over zazzy UI
* Excellent written clarity—able to write specs that reduce back\-and\-forth.
* Experience using tools like Jira, Confluence, Figma, or Testomat.io
* Ability to work in ambiguity—where the right next step is something you define


**You'll Love This Role If You:**
* Get energy from bringing order, clarity, and consistency
* Think in systems and dependencies, not isolated features
* Are comfortable being the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and QA
* Want to learn how a full\-scale enterprise SaaS platform is built from the inside out

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

As the Senior Fraud Strategy Data Analyst, you will play a key role in protecting our organization's integrity by analyzing fraud risk across the platform and supporting the development of strategies to address account takeover (ATO) fraud, suspicious activity detection, and fraud risk controls related to product access and adverse actions. You will leverage your analytical skills and business acumen to surface insights, build detection logic, and partner with data science, security, product, and compliance teams to strengthen our fraud prevention posture.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Analyze platform fraud trends and contribute to fraud risk control strategies for ATO, suspicious activity detection, and financial product access.
* Use SQL and Python to perform complex data analysis, build dashboards, and generate insights that inform risk management decisions and strategy development.
* Help design, test, and refine fraud detection rules and algorithms to identify and mitigate suspicious activities across the platform.
* Support the implementation of policies and controls that prevent unauthorized account access and adverse actions, partnering with security engineering on tracking and detection.
* Conduct data\-driven investigations to uncover fraud patterns, measure control performance, and recommend optimizations to detection methodologies.
* Perform cost\-benefit and impact analyses that balance fraud prevention with user experience and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate across teams — including Security, Sales, Customer Service, and Compliance — to support fraud monitoring and response workflows.
* Partner with R\&D on requirements for fraud detection and investigation tooling, providing data\-driven feedback to ensure they meet evolving business needs.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 4\+ years of experience in fraud prevention and detection, risk analytics, or a closely related analytical role, ideally within the financial technology sector.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related discipline); a Master's degree is preferred.
* Strong expertise in data analysis with demonstrated proficiency in SQL and Python for fraud detection, investigation, and strategy support.
* Solid understanding of account takeover risks, suspicious activity patterns, and fraud prevention methodologies.
* Familiarity with industry\-leading tools and third\-party risk vendors for fraud detection and analysis.
* Working knowledge of industry regulations and compliance requirements related to fraud risk management.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into clear recommendations for technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and a bias toward action in ambiguous problem spaces.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture.  Formulates and defines scope and objectives for complex, cross\-functional enhancements and operational improvements to the Ecolab Everyday product suite (mobile app, web dashboards/portals, web application, REM capabilities, and supporting onboarding/user\-management flows). This role will work primarily with QSR and Institutional customers. Operates in a global, matrixed business—partnering across regions, time zones, and languages to ensure requirements support scalable deployments and consistent customer outcomes. Serves as a senior liaison between Product, Engineering, Customer Success/Deployments, Support, and regional stakeholders to elicit, analyze, document, validate, and manage requirements from discovery through delivery. Proactively identifies process and product gaps, recommends solution options, and drives alignment on outcomes, tradeoffs, and release readiness.
   

  

 Typically requires a degree and 5\-8 years experience; or no degree and 9\-12 years combined education and equivalent work experience (typically 1 year experience \= 1 year education).
   

  

**Independence Level/Reports To**
 Applies advanced knowledge of digital product delivery and business analysis practices to independently drive requirements clarity, stakeholder alignment, and delivery outcomes across multiple workstreams in a global, matrixed environment. Leads ambiguity\-to\-clarity efforts and sets standards for requirement quality for the team.
   

  

**Typical Ecolab Everyday Senior BA Responsibilities Include**
* Own end\-to\-end requirements artifacts (epics/features, user stories, process flows) and define high\-quality acceptance criteria (edge cases, role/permission behavior, multi\-language behavior, and error/confirmation messaging) that enable efficient development and QA.
* Drive backlog refinement and readiness: break down work by component (mobile/server/web/CW/config), identify dependencies/risks (e.g., identity and access, vendor integrations/APIs, data/reporting), support estimation, and ensure work meets “ready” criteria before sprint commitment.
* Lead UAT and release readiness across stakeholders: define test strategy and scenarios, coordinate execution, ensure defects are triaged with clear problem statements, and confirm launch communications/documentation are complete.
* Translate VOC and field feedback into actionable backlog items: synthesize insights from surveys, customer sessions, pilot notes, and support trends; propose prioritization recommendations and success measures.
* Apply domain knowledge of QSR/Institutional environments (e.g., high\-frequency shift workflows, multi\-site/franchise operations, audits and compliance needs, limited connectivity scenarios) to ensure requirements are grounded in customer needs
* Partner with Engineering and Support on production triage: reproduce issues, define impact, propose requirement\-level fixes (including improved messaging and guardrails), validate resolutions, and help prevent recurrence through clearer requirements and test coverage.
* Assist Customer Success/Deployments with onboarding new customers by capturing and documenting onboarding\-specific requirements (e.g., SSO/JIT/SCIM/AFI, and any customer\- or market\-specific data needs) and translating them into actionable backlog items as needed.
* Mentor and peer\-review: work with other BAs and provide feedback on projects, features, and other work.

We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement.
